blocks.raw: <Tip>**Slope % Memory Aid:** Slope % = Rise ÷ Run × 100. For quick estimates: 1:10 slope ≈ 10%, 1:5 ≈ 20%, 1:3 ≈ 33%. Pedestrian ramp is 1:20 (≈5%, BP 344 2024 IRR), vehicle ramp is 1:6 (≈17%). Contours close together = steep; far apart = gentle.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Calculating slope as Run ÷ Rise instead of Rise ÷ Run (inverted formula)","Using 1:20 for pedestrian ramps instead of 1:12 (BP 344 2024 IRR)","Applying 1:8 for vehicular ramps instead of correct 1:6 (ERR-DSGN-026)","Misreading contour maps: assuming closely spaced contours indicate gentle slopes (opposite is true)","Forgetting the 2% minimum surface drainage slope requirement; assuming flat grades are acceptable","Confusing contour interval (on legend) with spacing (on map); not scaling correctly for slope calculation","Calculating cut-and-fill volumes without accounting for soil consolidation/settlement factors","Assuming positive drainage is optional; inadequate slope causes foundation damage"]} />
